body:
Main is available in the existing application. It groups whole projects into
Active, Paused and Archived columns, with folder/title filters, project opening
and conditional drag or menu status changes. It can be selected as the default
view.

The 601-test full gate passes. Main and navigation pass in Chromium and WebKit;
shared menus and the nine-view responsive checks also pass. The rebuilt manual
application verifies all 42 assets over its existing HTTPS address, preserving
31 prior source versions/hashes, two Focus pins, both profiles' settings,
registrations and roots, identity/epoch and certificate. A read-only live browser
shows all 15 existing projects. Full release acceptance remains open.

Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-main-project-board.md.

metadata.summary: Implemented and verified the Main project status board
